seo.title: Poon Hill Trek — 9 Days in Kathmandu and Pokhara | Adventure Access
seo.description: Nine days in Nepal: Kathmandu, Pokhara's Lakeside and a four-day trek to Poon Hill at 10,532 feet for sunrise over the Annapurnas. From $1,880.

intro.label: The Journey
intro.heading: Big Mountains, Short Trek
paragraphs: Ghodepani Poon Hill is a popular short trekking destination in the Annapurna region of Nepal. At 10,532 feet, it is known for its sunrise views over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges.

This classic trekking area is good for beginners, families and groups who want time among big mountains without spending weeks reaching the base camp regions. The trek sits between time in Kathmandu and Pokhara, with our guides handling the details from the moment you land.

dayTypes.label: How the Days Work
dayTypes.heading: City, Lake, Trail
dayTypes.lede: A short trip with a gentle shape: a few days to settle in, four days on the trail, and an easy finish.

cards.title: City days
cards.body: Days 1–2 in Kathmandu with a cultural tour in Boudha and your trek orientation, then Day 3 in Pokhara's Lakeside.

cards.title: Trekking days
cards.body: Days 4–7: three to seven hours on the trail each day, with Ghodepani at 9,383 feet and Poon Hill at 10,532 feet.

cards.title: Flight days
cards.body: Two short mountain flights, Kathmandu to Pokhara and back, with a celebration dinner in Thamel on Day 8.

chapters.label: The Journey in Chapters
chapters.heading: Nine Days in the Annapurna Region

groups.title: Kathmandu — Arrival and Orientation

image.alt: The eyes of Boudhanath stupa under prayer flags

prose: Your guide meets you at the airport, so there is no need to find your hotel in the back alleys of Boudha or Thamel on your own. There is still plenty of time to explore the city, eat well and get to know your guide before the mountains.

days.label: Day 1
days.text: Arrive in Kathmandu, meet your guide and transfer to your hotel.

days.label: Day 2
days.text: A cultural tour in Boudha, the trip orientation, and dinner with your guide and group.

groups.title: Pokhara — An Evening in Lakeside

image.alt: Machhapuchhre's pointed summit above forested slopes

prose: Pokhara is Nepal's second most populous city, but it feels very different from Kathmandu. It sits on the shore of Phewa Lake at 2,696 feet, with Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I and Manaslu all within 35 miles of the valley.

days.label: Day 3
days.text: Fly from Kathmandu to Pokhara and spend the evening in Lakeside, a laid-back neighborhood of local restaurants, shops and guesthouses.

groups.title: Poon Hill — Sunrise over the Annapurnas

image.alt: A stone path through the forest

prose: Four days on foot through the Annapurna region, with nights in local village guesthouses. Ghodepani Poon Hill, at 10,532 feet, is known for its sunrise views over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges.

days.label: Day 4
days.text: Drive to Hile and trek to Ulleri, about 3 hours. Altitude 6,430 ft.

days.label: Day 5
days.text: Trek to Ghodepani, about 6 hours. Altitude 9,383 ft.

days.label: Day 6
days.text: Trek to Tada Pani, about 7 hours. Altitude 8,629 ft.

days.label: Day 7
days.text: Trek to Ghandruk, about 3 hours, then drive back to Pokhara.

groups.title: Kathmandu — Celebration and Home
prose: A short flight back to the capital and a last dinner with your guides.

days.label: Day 8
days.text: A flight of about 30 minutes to Kathmandu, then a celebration dinner with your guides in Thamel.

days.label: Day 9
days.text: Your guide picks you up at the hotel and takes you to the airport for your flight.

pullQuote: Immersion in big mountains, without weeks on the trail.

goodToKnow.label: Good to Know
goodToKnow.heading: Before You Go
goodToKnow.lede: A few things that shape how this trip runs.

cards.title: Who it suits
cards.body: This classic trekking area is good for beginners, families and groups who want big mountains without multiple weeks on the trail.

cards.title: Altitude
cards.body: 10,000 feet is high for most people coming from the US or Europe, but relatively low for Nepal. Our guides watch how each guest is feeling and help you acclimatize the right way.

cards.title: Trek days
cards.body: The average trek day is 3–6 hours, with plenty of time to get from point to point. Evenings are spent in local village guesthouses, and your guides handle the details so you can focus on the trail.

cards.title: Kathmandu
cards.body: Your guide meets you at the airport and takes care of the details. Your time in the city includes good food, getting to know your guide and an orientation for the trek.

cards.title: Mountain flights
cards.body: Two short flights, Kathmandu to Pokhara and Pokhara to Kathmandu. Small planes like these are a classic part of travel in Nepal.

stays.label: Where You'll Stay
stays.heading: A City Hotel, Lakeside and the Trail
paragraphs: A hotel in Kathmandu at the start and end of the trip, an evening in Pokhara's Lakeside, and local village guesthouses on the trek.
